name: iCALL Psychosocial Helpline (Tata Institute of Social Sciences)
notes: Free telephone and email counselling by trained mental health professionals for anyone in emotional or psychological distress, across age, language, gender and sexual orientation. Anonymous. Email replies within 24 hours. Not an emergency service.

name: Vandrevala Foundation Mental Health Helpline
notes: Free mental health counselling and crisis support by trained counsellors, private and confidential. The site says you can call or WhatsApp from anywhere in India at any hour.

name: AASRA
address: 104, Sunrise Arcade, Plot No. 100, Sector 16, Koparkhairane, Navi Mumbai - 400709
notes: Crisis intervention helpline for emotional crisis, mental illness and suicidal thoughts, staffed by trained volunteers. General emotional support, not specific to violence against women. 022-27546667 is listed as the office quick contact.

name: Jan Sahas Helpline for Girls and Women
notes: Toll-free helpline for girls and women facing any kind of violence. Jan Sahas works with survivors of sexual violence and runs related helplines for shelter and counselling support.

name: Shakti Vahini
notes: Anti-human-trafficking organisation that works with police to rescue trafficked women and children. Also runs the India Cyber Tip Helpline for reporting online child sexual abuse material (report form on the site, or email cybertiphelpline@shaktivahini.net).

name: SNEHA Crisis Helpline (Prevention of Violence against Women and Children)
address: Crisis Centre, 310, 3rd Floor, Urban Health Center, 60 Feet Road, Dharavi, Mumbai 400 017
notes: Crisis helpline and walk-in crisis centre for women and children facing any kind of violence. SNEHA also lists a One-Stop Crisis Centre at KEM Hospital (022-24100511) and a mental health helpline (+91 89769 94777). The site gives 9833052684 / 9892278287 in its main text and 9833052684 / 9167535765 in its header.

name: Majlis Helpline (Rahat)
notes: Team of women lawyers and social workers. Rahat gives legal, social and mental health support to women and children who have faced sexual and domestic violence.

name: CEHAT Gender-based Violence Helpline
address: A-103 & B-103, First Floor, Moniz Tower, Yeshwant Nagar Road, Vakola, Santacruz (East), Mumbai - 400 055
notes: 24x7 helpline for women and girls facing violence, for support and assistance. CEHAT office telephone +91-9152 4419 49.

name: Arpan
address: 1001-1002, Atlanta Centre, Sonawala Road, Goregaon East, Mumbai 400063
notes: Works on preventing and healing child sexual abuse. Its helpline offers counselling to children and to adult survivors of childhood sexual abuse.

name: Stree Mukti Sanghatana Family Counseling Centres
notes: Family counselling centres for women facing violence in Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Pune, Kolhapur, Buldana and Osmanabad. Navi Mumbai centres: Vashi (7506427973, smsfcc.v@gmail.com) and Kamothe (8291765402, smsfcc.kl@gmail.com, Mon-Fri). See the district rows for other centres.

notes: Counselling for women facing violence. Parel 9324163495 (smsfcc.p@gmail.com). Chembur, Matoshree Ramabai Ambedkar Municipal Hospital Compound, R.C. Marg: 8291821061 (smsfcc.c@gmail.com). Vikhroli (W), Rotary Club of Mumbai Lakers: 8108437467 (smsfcc.lakers@gmail.com). The Powai centre uses the same number and is open Tue and Thu only.

notes: Counselling for women facing violence.

address: City Police Station Buldana, Maharashtra - 443001
notes: Family counselling centre and support room for women and children, located in the city police station.

name: Stree Mukti Sanghatana Support Room for Women and Children, Osmanabad
address: Police Superintendent Office, Osmanabad, Maharashtra - 413501
notes: Support room for women and children, located at the Police Superintendent Office.

address: 239 F Block, MIDC, Ahmednagar, Maharashtra 414111
notes: Free and confidential women's helpline. Snehalaya gives healthcare, rehabilitation and support to women and children facing violence and exploitation in Ahmednagar district. General office: +91 0241 2778353, info@snehalaya.org.

address: Maher, Survey Number 1295, Vadhu BK, Koregaon Bhima, Taluka Shirur, Dist. Pune- 412216
notes: Residential homes for women and children in distress, working for their safety, dignity and self-reliance.

name: Rescue Foundation
notes: Works with police and Anti-Human Trafficking Units to rescue girls trafficked into prostitution, then gives shelter, healthcare, mental health support and vocational training. Runs four licensed shelter homes in Mumbai, Palghar, Pune and Delhi.

name: Shakti Shalini
address: 6/30-B, Basement, Kargil Park Lane, Jangpura B, New Delhi 110014
notes: Supports survivors of gender and sexual violence: 24x7 helpline, crisis intervention and counselling centre, and the Pehchan shelter home. Office line 011-24372437.

name: Jagori Helpline (Counselling & Support Services for GBV)
address: B-114, Shivalik, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi 110 017
notes: Counselling and support services for women facing gender-based violence.

name: Swayam

notes: Free, confidential support for women and children who have faced domestic violence or abuse, through a crisis centre in Bengaluru and a pan-India helpline. The toll-free number 1 800 103 9548 was temporarily down when checked; use 99806 60548.

name: PCVC (International Foundation for Crime Prevention and Victim Care)
notes: Support from crisis intervention to long-term healing for women, children and queer people facing violence at home or in relationships. Survivor support email: dvsupport@pcvconline.org.

name: Sayodhya Home for Women in Need
address: Sayodhya Home GHMC Community Hall, Opposite D-MART Kamala nagar, Golnaka, Amberpet, Hyderabad
notes: Emergency shelter for women, 24-hour helpline, counselling and legal advice. Free legal aid clinic on Saturdays, with help at police and court.

name: Shaheen Women's Resource and Welfare Association
notes: Women-led grassroots organisation in the Old City of Hyderabad. Women facing domestic and social violence, especially from Muslim, Dalit and other marginalised communities, walk in for support and intervention.

name: Sakhi Women's Resource Centre
address: Convent Rd, Vanchiyoor, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695035
notes: Helps women and girls who face violence at home and in public places. The site publishes no phone number; contact by email or visit.

name: Vanangana
notes: Legal and emotional support for women facing domestic violence, dowry harassment, sexual harassment and child abuse in Chitrakoot and Banda districts. A second phone link on the site is incomplete and has been left out.
